Good evening, Eduardo. Renata Lima, from the academic office. I am sending you four changes for this week. The Tuesday seminar is moving to Wednesday, because Professor Hughes is travelling. We are closing the library on Thursday morning, and the builders are working there until noon. I am reading the proposals now, and I am answering every student before Friday. Your supervisor is asking for an update. Please submit one page before Wednesday. I am in the office tomorrow, from nine to five.

Eduardo, Paulo here. I am calling from the port. I am looking at the queue right now, and I am counting forty ships outside Santos. Our vessel is waiting since Tuesday. We are paying eleven thousand dollars a day for that. The agent is talking to the terminal this morning, but he is not promising anything. The buyer is asking me for a new date, and I am not answering him before I talk to you. Currently we are five days late. Please call me back.
